prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface concept at 1440×900 for Ardor’s interactive User manual
Primary request: Design a complete web page screenshot for an interactive learning surface. This is Option A, “Instrument + sidecar”.
Structure: a compact existing-style top navigation rail; below it, a two-column workspace. The left 68% contains a very large, dimensionally faithful front/top view of the supplied Ardor pedal. The right 32% is one continuous contextual manual sidecar, not a stack of cards. A thin bottom strip shows hold progress and detected input. Content below the fold begins with a switch-combination matrix.
Interaction state: Footswitch 1 and Footswitch 2 are simultaneously depressed; leader lines connect both switches to the sidecar; a one-second progress rule is at 70%; the pedal screen says TUNER ENTRY; the sidecar explains FS1 + FS2, HOLD 1 SECOND, Mute output and open tuner.
Visual world: Ardor’s established playable nomenclature plate: graphite, slate, bone lettering, muted labels, hard hairline rules, live red only for active state, square geometry, calibrated ticks and bracket corners.
Subject/reference: preserve the supplied pedal’s proportions, four-switch corner layout, centered widescreen touchscreen, rear-center rotary encoder, textured black enclosure and metal footswitches.
Constraints: a usable web interface screenshot, not a poster; no browser chrome, marketing hero, floating rounded cards, gradients, neon glow, glass, decorative grid, extra controls, fake claims, or logos besides ARDOR.
